svg.text: GK2A L2 Forest Fire product: observation-slot availability
March 2025 Gyeongbuk wildfires — hourly probe of the Korea-area (KO) product tree, 2025-03-21 to 2025-04-04 KST
A filled cell means the operational fire-detection product was published for that observation slot. It does NOT mean a fire was detected.
Source: nmsc.kma.go.kr public product tree, retrieved 2026-09-20, no credential required.
635 of 650 probed slots retrieved. All 15 misses fall in 00:40–00:48 UTC, the documented daily wheel-offload gap.
